name: Hy4 (preview)
short: Tencent's Aug 2026 open-weight 770B/49B-active MoE (Apache 2.0, 1M ctx): vendor Terminal-Bench 2.1 85.4% vs Vals 55.1%, GPQA 92.3% - not on Zen.
pricingNote: Apache 2.0 open weights; hosted ~$0.75/$2.25 per 1M (OpenRouter), self-host $0
standout: Tencent’s 1M+-context self-host flagship: open MoE weights aimed at long-running agentic coding on private infrastructure.
tradeoff: Evidence is vendor-only — the one independent agentic run lands 30 points below the vendor Terminal-Bench score.
